en: a simple style of language of the type that parents use when speaking to their child
a very offensive word used to show great anger or dislike towards somebody, especially a man
the state of being a mother
ex: Motherhood suits her.
她很适合做母亲。

en: the act of caring for and protecting children or other people
ex: an example of good/poor mothering
良好呵护的范例；照顾不周的例子

zh: 母亲节（在英国为大斋期的第四个星期日，美国为五月的第二个星期日）
en: Mother's Day (= a day on which mothers traditionally receive cards and gifts from their children, celebrated in the UK on the fourth Sunday in Lent and in the US on the second Sunday in May)
the country that you were born in and that you feel a strong emotional connection with
ex: He was willing to die for the motherland.
他愿意为祖国而死。

en: having no mother because she has died or does not live with you
ex: children left motherless
孩子们失去母亲

en: having the qualities of a good mother; typical of a mother
ex: motherly love
慈母般的爱
